purpose: Audited Happy8 structured screening, falsification and stability analysis. It must preserve scientific non-deception and must not claim betting returns or predictive edge without evidence.
five_why: Users need one coherent desktop workflow instead of an unaudited recovered browser prototype.
A coherent workflow requires verified production data, not browser/localStorage or test fixtures.
Verified data requires fail-closed Source/NetClient/Storage/Evidence boundaries with canonical hashes and provenance.
Predictions require independent scientific validation against random/simple baselines and false-gain controls.
A trustworthy Windows product requires exact EXE, real GUI clicks, independent updater/repair, same-hash and release evidence tied to one artifact.
risk_boundaries: No betting advice, return guarantee or fabricated predictive edge.
NO_EDGE must remain a valid production truth state with NULL_DAN and uniform baseline.
Mock/fixture/local cache cannot satisfy Real Network or production business evidence.
Raw data cannot enter results until validated and canonicalized.
Missing independent release/repository/update credentials remain BLOCKED, never locally simulated as production PASS.
Behavior changes invalidate affected downstream evidence.

functions.output: rank-1..80 research ranking, candidates, truth state and immutable freeze hash

functions.failure: BLOCKED/FAIL when real trusted release is unavailable

functions.output: component repair evidence and post-repair self-check
functions.failure: FAIL for unrecoverable corruption; BLOCKED for external release/network config
fail closed when science software gate fails

final_requirements: unique final artifact and release evidence PASS
